prompts.title: Recent form: rhythm of results
prompts.prompt: Editorial variant: vertical 9:16 composition on GoatLab charcoal #101412 with warm white #edf0e6 typography and lime #c5ed74 accents. Keep the lower quarter clear for permanent yellow subtitles. Use rhythmic typography: 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES', 'DERROTAS' pulse in sequence as abstract tick marks tick like a metronome, never forming axes or claiming sample values. Both teams share one common count scale with a shared baseline, and the bars are color-coded warm white for Deportivo Alavés and slate #8ca6bf for Málaga CF.
